abstract: Normal mesenchymal cells, normal epithelial cells and many transformed epithelial cells require serum attachment factors and extracellular matrix proteins for growth and differentiation in vitro, and recent evidence strongly supports a role for extracellular matrix molecules in the regulation of cell movement in vivo during early embryogenesis. We previously described the isolation and characterization of cell lines representative of three types of stem cells most commonly found in human adult testicular teratomas, namely embryonal carcinoma cells, yolk sac carcinoma cells resembling visceral endoderm and yolk sac carcinoma cells resembling parietal endoderm (endodermal sinus tumour cells). Of these three cell types, only endodermal sinus tumour cells, which show particularly malignant behaviour in vivo, have no serum requirement for attachment and growth in vitro. Supernatants from endodermal sinus tumour cells support the attachment of embryonal carcinoma cells in serum-free medium. We demonstrate here that endodermal sinus tumour cells, but not other cell types isolated from testicular teratomas, secrete the serum attachment protein, vitronectin (also known as serum-spreading factor, S-protein or epibolin), as well as fibronectin, laminin and type IV collagen, into serum-free medium. Purified vitronectin from medium conditioned by endodermal sinus tumour cells supported both attachment and spreading of embryonal carcinoma cells in vitro, whereas cells attached but did not spread properly on surfaces coated with fibronectin or laminin. Peptides containing the RGD cell recognition sequence common to many attachment proteins blocked attachment of endodermal sinus tumour cells to untreated tissue-culture plastic in serum-free medium. The results suggest a possible role for vitronectin in regulating cell motility and growth in early development, and in the invasion and spread of teratomas in vivo.
abstract_ja: 正常間葉系細胞、正常上皮細胞および多くの形質転換上皮細胞は、in vitroでの増殖と分化に血清接着因子と細胞外基質タンパク質を必要とし、細胞外基質分子が初期胚発生における生体内での細胞運動の調節に役割を果たすことを、最近の知見が強く支持している。我々は以前、ヒト成人精巣奇形腫に最も一般的にみられる3種類の幹細胞、すなわち胎児性癌細胞、内臓内胚葉様の卵黄嚢癌細胞、壁側内胚葉様の卵黄嚢癌細胞（卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞）の代表的な細胞株の単離と特性解析を報告した。これら3種の細胞型のうち、生体内で特に悪性の挙動を示す卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞のみが、in vitroでの接着と増殖に血清を必要としない。卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞の上清は、無血清培地中で胎児性癌細胞の接着を支持する。本研究では、卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞のみが血清接着タンパク質であるビトロネクチン（血清拡散因子、Sタンパク質、エピボリンとも呼ばれる）を、フィブロネクチン、ラミニン、IV型コラーゲンとともに無血清培地へ分泌することを示す。卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞の培地から精製したビトロネクチンは、胎児性癌細胞の接着と伸展をin vitroで支持したが、フィブロネクチンまたはラミニンでコートした表面では細胞は接着したものの適切に伸展しなかった。多くの接着タンパク質に共通するRGD細胞認識配列を含むペプチドは、無血清培地中で未処理の組織培養プラスチックへの卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞の接着を阻害した。結果は、初期発生における細胞運動と増殖の調節、ならびに生体内での奇形腫の浸潤と拡がりにおけるビトロネクチンの役割の可能性を示唆する。
